name: Workshop Manager
description: Runs a workshop: a student roster, a Folder per student synced from a Template Folder (the first sync copies it, each later one keeps the student's copy in step), and watched files (an FAQ) whose student edits show on the roster

charmiq.command.name: getRoster
charmiq.command.description: List the workshop's students, sorted by name: each one's name, email, CharmIQ User, whether they are deleted (deleted students stay listed and can be restored), how many items their folder holds from the template, how many of their copies they have edited (as of the last sync), when they were last synced, and their folder's URL

active.description: How many students are not deleted

charmiq.command.name: getConfig
charmiq.command.description: Return the workshop's configuration: the Template Folder synced to each student, the Classroom Folder the students' folders are made in, the student folder name pattern, the Owners added to each student folder, and whether syncing can run (and why not)

charmiq.command.name: syncRoster
charmiq.command.description: Make the roster match a list of people. Each listed person who is not an active student is added (a deleted student is restored); each active student the list does not name is marked deleted (restorable; their folder is untouched). Everyone must have a CharmIQ account: an email with no CharmIQ User is reported and not added. Nothing is synced; call syncAll afterwards to make new students' folders

list.description: The people, one per line, each with their email address ("Jane Doe <jane@example.com>", "jane@example.com" or "Doe, Jane, jane@example.com"), or an array of those lines or of { email, name } objects. The name is optional; without one the CharmIQ profile name is used

noCharmiqUser.description: Emails with no CharmIQ account; not added

couldNotCheck.description: Emails the user search failed for; their students are kept

charmiq.command.name: addStudent
charmiq.command.description: Add one student by their email address (a deleted student with that email is restored). They must have a CharmIQ account. Nothing is synced; call syncStudent afterwards

name.description: The name shown in the roster and used for their folder; defaults to their CharmIQ profile name

charmiq.command.name: removeStudent
charmiq.command.description: Mark a student deleted. They stay listed and can be restored with addStudent; their folder and copies are untouched

student.description: The student's email address or name

charmiq.command.name: renameStudent
charmiq.command.description: Rename a student. Their folder is renamed too, unless the student has renamed it themselves

student.description: The student's email address or current name

charmiq.command.name: syncStudent
charmiq.command.description: Sync one student: the first sync copies the Template Folder into a new folder for them; each later one brings their copy in step (additions, moves, updates, removals, and recreating copies the student deleted). A copy the student has edited is never overwritten or deleted here: it is reported under needsDecision, for the person to decide with Sync in the workshop

student.description: The student's email address or name

charmiq.command.name: syncAll
charmiq.command.description: Sync every active student, one at a time, as syncStudent does for one. Edited copies are reported under needsDecision for each student, never overwritten or deleted

notCopyable.description: Template entries that are not copied (Files and other kinds)

charmiq.command.name: whatChanged
charmiq.command.description: What one student changed in their folder: copies they edited since the workshop last wrote them, files they made themselves (not from the template), and template copies gone from their folder (deleted or moved out; the next sync recreates them). Reads the student's folder now: one read per folder plus one per synced document

student.description: The student's email address or name

edited.description: Each with name, url and when it was last updated

missing.description: Template entries whose copy is gone from the folder

charmiq.command.name: checkWatchedFiles
charmiq.command.description: Check the files the workshop watches (an FAQ students write in): reads every active student's copy now and answers, per student and file, whether it is new (edited since it was last marked seen in the workshop), seen, deleted, unreadable or not synced yet, with a link to the copy. The teacher chooses the watched files in the workshop's Settings
